subject: Labor: health and safety
bill.title: Labor: health and safety; occupational health standards related to exposure to work in hot environments; require director to promulgate. Amends 1974 PA 154 (MCL 408.1001 - 408.1094) by adding sec. 14s.

posted_text:
🦺 Labor & Workers' Rights
MI HB 6442 — Michigan Could Require Employers to Protect Workers From Extreme Heat

Bill would force companies to create plans to prevent heat injuries, including setting up heat monitoring systems and providing regular water breaks and rest periods based on temperature levels. Employers would also need to track employee health data and train workers on how to avoid heat hazards, with a ban on retaliation for reporting concerns. ...
